verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents sandbox simulation endpoints (/simulations/cardtransactions/*), one per transaction event type, and explicitly names authorizations and reversals among them. A Quick Start walks through simulating a transaction, and the JIT funding docs describe approving or denying funding requests with your own rules, so the core auth-testing loop is supported. Only two of the five named lifecycle events are explicitly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit evidence of clearing/settlement simulation, refund simulation, simulated declines driven by spend controls or JIT responses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
